title: Say your prompt out loud instead of typing it
blurb: Turns on dictation so you can talk to Claude instead of typing. Your voice is turned into text on your own computer — nothing is recorded or sent anywhere, and it costs nothing to use.
newcomerProblem: Typing out a long prompt is slow, and you think faster than you type.
tryThisExplain: Run that in a second terminal, then speak. Your words appear wherever your cursor is.
explain: Your computer listens through the microphone and types out what you say, wherever your cursor happens to be — including the box where you talk to Claude. The listening part runs entirely on your own machine, so your voice never leaves it and there is nothing to pay for.
honestLimit: This types into whatever window you're already in — it doesn't add a microphone button inside Claude Code. It also needs a one-time setup on your computer first, and the kit tells you exactly what to run.
uninstallNote: This removes the shortcut. Anything you installed on your computer yourself stays where it is.
